about: The one list of object categories REACH knows about. Supported targets are the native ones: bottle, laptop, book, backpack, handbag, cup (model_support: native = the current model has the class and REACH targets it; none = REACH wants it but the model has no class; excluded = never a target, either deliberately (person, scissors) or because it is outside the supported set). Ids are stable so existing annotations stay valid. Annotators label these names; the evaluator scores them; training uses their ids (0 is reserved for background). model_labels = which labels of the CURRENT detector (efficientdet_lite0.tflite, COCO) count as this category. A unit test (CategorySpecTest) keeps this file, SupportedClasses and the model's embedded labels in agreement.

categories.name: bottle
categories.note: COCO 'bottle' covers water/soda/wine bottles; drink cans are often reported as bottle/cup/vase

categories.name: laptop
categories.note: a closed or rear-facing dark lid is often missed (A15 recorded frames: read as backpack 0.22-0.30)

categories.name: laptop bag
categories.note: no COCO class; needs custom training. The app says it cannot recognise laptop bags

categories.name: wine glass
categories.note: COCO has 'wine glass' but it is outside the supported set; REACH says it cannot recognise it
